subject: 🏃 Thursday — 6 mi Progression + Fuel Rehearsal (Wk 2)
html:
Tomorrow: 6 mi progression run — Week 2 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation & Durability. 72 days to race day. This run does double duty: progression stimulus + first fuel rehearsal for Sunday's B2B.

The run: 4 mi @ 9:00 easy, then 2 mi at threshold pace 7:15–7:25. Standard 5-min activation before you head out: quadruped hip CARs, banded lateral walks, glute bridges, plus the PT-prescribed quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side).

The hill rule (final 0.5 mi home is uphill): Switch from pace to HR for the climb. Lock the first 1.5 mi of the threshold block to 7:15–7:25 on the flat, then on the uphill half mile target 155–162 BPM on the Polar H10 (threshold band). Hard cap 165. Let pace drift to whatever it lands at — chasing 7:15 up a hill turns threshold into VO2 and defeats the workout.

Fuel rehearsal — this is the dry run for B2B:

WhenWhatPurpose
5:30 AM (30 min pre-run)25 g carb: banana + ½ slice toast, OR 1 Maurten Gel 100. 8 oz water + electrolyte (Skratch / LMNT / half-strength Maurten 320).Top off liver glycogen, get fluid on board.
~Mile 3.5 (just before threshold)1 gel, ~25 g carb (Maurten Gel 100 default).Stress the gut at threshold pace — closest analog to Sunday's MP finish.
Post-run (within 30 min)30+ g protein (4 eggs or 1.5 cup Greek yogurt + berries).Standard repair window.

Pay attention to GI feel during and after the gel. If anything sits poorly — cramping, sloshing, nausea — we adjust the brand or timing for Sunday. If it's seamless, we're locked for B2B (same protocol scaled up: gel at mile 3 + gel at mile 6, ~40 g/hr).

Focus cue: Keep cadence sticky in the threshold block. You held 167 spm clean on Tuesday's 800s. If pace and HR are both honest, cadence will be too. On the uphill 0.5 mi, shorten the stride and let cadence carry you up; do not lengthen and grind.

Knee veto: 2/5 in the morning → drop the threshold portion, run the full 6 easy at 9:00, still do the gel rehearsal (the fueling test is independent of the pace stimulus).

Prep tonight: Lay out gel + electrolyte mix on the counter. Set 5:15 alarm. Bed by 10. PT follow-up Friday — bring her the week's data.
